card.fact_statement: The Xiaomi YU7 comes with a standard 14-speaker sound system.
card.source_span: It is equipped with a standard 14-speaker or an optional 25-speaker sound system

target_qa_variants.question: ما هو حجم النظام الصوتي القياسي المضمن في شاومي YU7؟
target_qa_variants.source_span: It is equipped with a standard 14-speaker or an optional 25-speaker sound system
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated directly. In Arabic grammar, numbers 11-99 take a singular noun, so '14-speaker' and '14 speakers' translate to the same phrase '14 مكبر صوت'. Added '14 سماعة' as a valid alias for speakers.

backtranslation_en.question: What is the size of the standard audio system included in the Xiaomi YU7?
